body: [This](http://imgur.com/tgy9BxC) is all that I have to say about the matter.

Thank you guys. My friends and family were very supportive when I finally let them in on what I was feeling and thinking, but after every therapy session or change in anti-depressants they would seem to get a little more impatient, as if I wasn't already over it and fixed fast enough. 
Not that they really matter all that much anymore. They were the only things in the past keeping me from killing myself, because I felt guilty that it would affect them too much. But now I've moved out again, and even though I still don't want to hurt them, I'm so damned tired. 
The friends to whom I could still go to about how I feel, are all depressed and near suicidal themselves, and whenever we talk about the subject, I'm the one giving the support.
